<!-- pr-reviewer: 646221da3df7326604f82e78c5f8b9a5d9b009ce -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. No blocking defect was found.

What looks good:
- The model excess is passed to the cross-drill entry, reach, holder, part, and rapid checks.
- The tests check both the tighter limit and the refusal when no tolerance remains.
- No UI files, build scripts, dependencies, or golden files change. Screenshots are not required.

Local results after a trial merge with upstream/main at `6d6015ea19a15d0a0ac5f61c95406c1680eefec4`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Application operation unit tests (`cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib operation::`) | 168 passed |
| Application integration tests: `coarse_cross_drill`, `coarse_laws`, `cross_drill_neighbours`, `drill_reach`, `drill_reach_fit`, `drilling_cross`, `drilling_cross_box`, `drilling_cross_holder`, `drilling_cross_part`, `drilling_cross_rapids`, `drilling_cross_spindle`, `drilling_cross_stock`, `stock_source_cross_drill` | 70 passed |
| Simulation unit tests | 160 passed |
| Simulation integration tests: `coarse_collision`, `model_excess`, `radial_rapids` | 27 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

All builds and tests ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-1755`, with its own target directory. No GitHub runner was used. These are selected tests for the changed checks; the full workspace test suite was not run.

I repeated two mutations:
1. Removed the radial-rapid top growth and disc tolerance change. The new coarse radial-rapid test failed: it returned no warning instead of `RapidInStock { at: 0 }`. After restoration, the test passed.
2. Removed the tighter cross-part tolerance. The new coarse hole-floor test failed: generation accepted the cut that the test must refuse. After restoration, the test passed.

The mutations were removed. The working tree matches the local trial-merge commit. No golden files moved.

Requested before merge: none.

Note: the live part check in `kept_rejudge` and the holder swing branch have no separate new coarse-model test. This review checked the code in those paths and ran the existing cross-drill tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
